entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah with VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Cadence Sensor. It's not what I expected and I want my money back immediately.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the sensor? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a preference! It's a piece of junk. I don't want it. I've had it for a few weeks and I want to send it back. I expect a full refund, and don't try to give me the runaround.
I understand. I just need to pull up your order to proceed. Can I have your email address?

It's vip-customer@example.com. And let me be clear, I'm not interested in hearing that it's too late or some new policy about hygiene. I've been a good customer for years, and I will write a review that reflects how this call goes. Get me a manager if you can't handle this.
I'm confident I can resolve this for you. Thank you for that information. I see your order here, delivered 25 days ago. Please give me one moment to review the return eligibility for your item.
This is ridiculous. It better be eligible. Don't you dare come back with some excuse about sanitation or health codes. I barely even used the thing.

Thank you for your patience. I've checked the return policy for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, and you are absolutely correct. Your purchase is well within our 90-day return window. I can process this for you right now.
Oh. So... you're just approving it? No fight?

That's right. It's an immediate approval. I've just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email on file. Just pack the item in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, a full refund will be processed.
Huh. Okay then. That's... good. That's what I wanted. Thank you.
You are very welcome. I'm glad I could help resolve this quickly for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
